Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Stop Motion]]: Phil Tippett at Industrial Light & Magic with the stop-motion puppet of a tauntaun and its rider, made for ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980). StarWars.com captions it "Phil Tippett manipulates stop-motion puppets of the tauntaun and AT-AT walkers."

Source: [https://www.starwars.com/news/hoth-behind-the-scenes Creating a Winter Wonderland on Hoth], StarWars.com (image file image_68123b69.jpeg, 1024 by 687 pixels). Reduced to 640 by 429 pixels. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260916200326/https://www.starwars.com/news/hoth-behind-the-scenes Internet Archive], 16 September 2026. SHA-256 of the downloaded file: 408ed661458005cd51a367473fcc16dab77217fe701cea79fc55df0ccaeec2b2.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a low-resolution copy (640 by 429 pixels) of a production photograph, © Lucasfilm Ltd., shown to identify the stop-motion tauntaun puppet the card's title refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
